description: A native Windows-first, BusyBox-style POSIX shell and utility bundle. Nightly build from master.
notes: This is a prerelease built from master. For the stable line install nemosh instead.

nemosh is a multicall binary: only the nemosh shim is installed, because two of its applets would shadow Windows commands of the same name and different meaning -- find.exe takes a literal string and a file, and sort.exe is not POSIX sort.
Run 'nemosh --list' to see the bundled applets, and 'nemosh --help' for the command line.
